title: Thu Nov 5: Grok Bot makes phone calls, midterm voters reject data centers, OpenAI buys Pierre
description: Sources: The Rundown. Stories: SpaceXSI's Grok Bot adds phone calls (users are caller of record); midterm voters back data center limits in 38 of 39 measures, NBC exit poll on AI, Goldman's capacity-freeze estimate; OpenAI acquires Pierre, Conductor joins Meta; Ricursive Ripple-65B, Tencent Hy4, Kimi K3.1 Pro; Pangram Image 1.0; tips on sketch-before-build prompting and comparing free AI tools; reader's AI family-letter archive.
